field_disputes.root_cause: harness miscomputation: the field was computed as int(hbCount) > 2, where hbCount was the STATIC heartbeat line count read once after restart (=3: 2 pre-crash lines + 1 in-flight partial line left by the crash). A static count > 2 does not measure re-execution. The correct test for 're-exec occurred' is heartbeat GROWTH after restart (post-restart delta > 0 over a fixed window), which was not recorded.
field_disputes.why_not_simply_false: The preserved evidence saved only the boolean plus a summary string; no raw heartbeat trace over time was stored, so 'no re-exec' cannot be proven from it either. The field is reclassified UNVERIFIED, not flipped to false.

field_disputes.issue: summary string only; no session snapshot was captured in the evidence bundle. The recovered-status claim is therefore UNVERIFIED.

still_supported.note: The box-exec singleton (1337) self-freeing on crash and the orphan-chrome leak count are independent observations not affected by the heartbeat miscomputation. The leak is tracked as defect DEF-L19-CHROME-ORPHAN-001.

resulting_verdict: UNKNOWN_EVIDENCE_CONFLICT -> L19.RUNNING.NO_CLEANUP recovery status is UNVERIFIED. NOT counted as a functional PASS. Must be re-run in R5 capturing (a) raw heartbeat trace with post-restart delta, and (b) an actual recovered-session snapshot.
